verdicts.reason: The two layouts are nearly identical. In both, the headline wraps into four lines with an awkward 'and a little / sunshine.' break, and the CTA pill is oversized, so it competes with the headline. The LIMITED badge plus button cluster also sits slightly left of centre, with the badge close to the left edge. A edges ahead because its block is placed a little lower, closer to the original's vertical balance. B sits higher and leaves a larger empty band at the bottom (~170px), which makes it more top-heavy.
